svg.title: The road so far
svg.desc: JUL 2024: Made the account (then nineteen quiet months) → MAR 2026: First two repos public (a Flask app and a PWA in 48 hours) → JUN 2026: Two AI & ML internships (Litmus7 on-site, Cognifyz remote) → AUG 2026: Three apps in three days (all deployed, all live on Vercel) → SEP 2026: Campus Hub, in a week (~10k lines of TypeScript, one deploy) → NOW: Boat safety system (final-year project, sensing rig first)
svg.text: a Flask app and a PWA in 48 hours
all deployed, all live on Vercel
